Aisha: Heads up team — my planned streamer (R. Delgado) just put up 28 pts and 11 boards in garbage time. Waiver wire chaos incoming? :exploding_head:

Jordi: screenshot? stats?

Samira: lmao the waiver algorithm is cursed. who drops to grab him?

Tom: I can drop Carter for Delgado but Carter has a 3x multi-cat upside
Aisha: if anyone wants him I can hold for a few hours, but first come first serve
Jordi: @Aisha hold pls, trying to see if my opponent will auto-bench their big
Samira: btw league chat poll: keep or cut? 
Samira: keep — 6
Tom: cut — 2
Ben: keep — 3
Aisha: already moved him to my active slot. feel like i stole a full game
ops-bot: Reminder: waivers process at 02:00 UTC. Manual claims allowed until then.
Tom: gg @Aisha, fantasy gods blessed you tonight :raised_hands:
Jordi: who wants bragging rights for the next week? I'm starting a #sleeper-brag thread
Samira: i'll meme it up. gif war incoming :trophy:
Ben: also quick PSA — don't forget to lock lineups before thursday noon, heard people lost players to auto-lock
Aisha: cheers y'all. if this keeps up i might be trading him for a mid-tier 3B anchor :money_mouth_face:
Tom: bet. will accept trade offers if you want to convert this luck to stability
Jordi: congrats! also, next week's matchup reminder in #fantasy-league-tips
Samira: i'll draft a 2-line victory chant
